description: This PHP source file defines the AuthorizationCodeRepository class for managing OAuth authorization codes within the OrangeHRM system's OAuth plugin. It implements methods for persisting, revoking, and verifying authorization codes, interfacing with the database through Doctrine ORM.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling OAuth authorization codes, including persistence, revocation, and status checks, within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Persists a new OAuth authorization code to the database using data from an AuthCodeEntityInterface object.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Marks an existing authorization code as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a given authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AuthCodeEntity used for creating a new authorization code.
